public_rationale: Part of this holds. OpenAI released Operator as an early research preview it did not expect to be reliable. An independent test found Deep Research significantly worse than human researchers, with confident errors and weak sources. The same test noted that many people were seriously impressed at launch, which fits his point about applause. But "barely brush against their intended purposes" overstates it. OpenAI's launch figures show the model behind Operator succeeded on 58% to 87% of web tasks on standard benchmarks. FutureSearch also found Deep Research better than some competing systems. So the products were flawed and unfinished, not near-useless by these measures.
limitations: "Half-products" and "barely" are value judgments with no threshold.
Operator's benchmark figures come from OpenAI.
Media reception was not measured systematically.
